title: Fulfilment Centre Shipping Rule: Refill Pattern and Advance Notice Listing, Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program
content:
## Fulfilment Centre Shipping Rule — refill pattern and the units an advance notice lists

**Scope.** Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program, CGM Original Medicare Program, CGM supply allowance (item A4239). The rule fixes which quantity a customer's Medicare advance beneficiary notice (form CMS-R-131) lists, according to how the program's refills of the item ship.

**Rule.** This rule replaces what the notice lists by how the program's refills ship: when the latest refill of the item carries the customer's refill confirmation date, the notice lists the next delivery; when refills of the item are on record but the latest carries no confirmation date, the notice lists every unit left on the grant the next delivery draws on; otherwise the standard listing applies, the notice listing one standard shipment.

**Meaning of the terms.**

1. *Refill confirmation date*: the date, recorded on a refill shipment, on which the customer confirmed continued use of the item for that shipment. Only the refill shipment of item A4239 with the latest ship date is read for it.
2. *Refills on record*: one or more refill shipments of item A4239 on the program.
3. *The next delivery*: the notice lists the billing units of item A4239 the program's next refill delivery carries.
4. *Every unit left on the grant the next delivery draws on*: the notice lists that grant's units left as they stand, a number of billing units, without turning them into 30-day blocks.
5. *The standard listing, one standard shipment*: the notice lists the whole 30-day blocks in the tier's standard days of supply per refill shipment, multiplied by the tier's sensor allowance units per 30 days of supply.

**Shipping-pattern table.**

| Refill shipments of A4239 on record | Latest refill shows a refill confirmation date | The notice lists |
|---|---|---|
| 1 or more | Yes | The units of the next delivery |
| 1 or more | No | Every unit left on the grant the next delivery draws on |
| None | — | The standard listing: one standard shipment |

Only the latest refill's confirmation date decides between the first two rows; a confirmation date on an earlier refill does not.

**Hypothetical illustration.** Suppose the next delivery carries 3 units, the grant it draws on has 7 units left, and one standard shipment would be 4 units.

- The latest refill shows a confirmation date: the notice lists 3 units.
- Refills are on record, but the latest shows no confirmation date: the notice lists 7 units.
- The program has no refill shipment of the item yet: the notice lists 4 units.
